payload.title: Every LLM call uses gpt-6-luna: priming gateway, console picker, guard test
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-02: GPT 5.4 Mini spend seen today; all LLM calls use GPT 6 Luna. Moves the priming provider budget gateway (MODEL, Luna rates, reservation), removes non-Luna entries from the console model picker and the console chat responder allowlist, moves .kanbus.yml ai.model, adds a guard test that fails on any other OpenAI model identifier in product code (speech models allowed). Needs a Biblicus release with gpt-6-luna and a pin bump to take effect.
